paper.title_en: History-Dependent Mode Selection in a Driven Holographic Superfluid
paper.abstract_en: We study finite-rate mode selection among competing Landau-unstable modes in a holographic superfluid. The selected mode is not generally the instantaneous fastest-growing one, while time-dependent linear evolution on the driven background reproduces the full dynamics. Protocols with identical present driving conditions can exhibit opposite modal ordering, revealing memory of the preceding drive. This memory is quantitatively captured by the accumulated difference between the QNM growth rates of the competing modes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究全息超流体中的模式选择，具有明确的理论深度和方法论严谨性。新颖性体现在揭示了历史依赖性和记忆效应，且与全息凝聚态物理和广义相对论基础相关。
decision.title_zh: 驱动全息超流体中的历史依赖模式选择
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了全息超流体中相互竞争的Landau不稳定模式的有限速率模式选择。所选模式通常不是瞬时增长最快的模式，而对驱动背景的时间依赖线性演化可以再现完整动力学。具有相同当前驱动条件的协议可以表现出相反的模态排序，揭示了先前驱动的记忆。这种记忆由竞争模式的QNM增长率之间的累积差异定量捕获。
